summary.text: PCV20 may cause soreness, headache, body aches, tiredness or fever. These usually settle within a few days.

details.heading: Injection site reactions
details.body: You may have pain, redness or swelling where the vaccine was given.

details.heading: Other common effects
details.body: You may also have a headache, body aches, fatigue or fever. Most side effects are mild or moderate and usually resolve within a few days.

quotes.text: However, similar to other vaccines, individuals may experience common side effects which include injection site reactions (e.g., pain, redness, swelling), headache, body aches, fatigue and fever.
